content.short: Meson is a stablecoin swap protocol enabling cross-chain stablecoin flows.
content.description: Meson is a stablecoin swap protocol that enables fast, cross-chain flows of major stablecoins across Ethereum, Layer 2 networks, and other high-performance public chains. Swaps settle in 1-2 minutes, faster than most cross-chain bridges, and are gas-free for Meson users, with zero fees on the most popular routes. The protocol has been audited by Trail of Bits and SSLabs at Georgia Tech, and Meson offers an intuitive UI with 24/7 multilingual support for a smooth cross-chain experience.
